what_it_is: Saved early, aboard Koopa Cruiser. Mario & Luigi are Level 255 with 999 in all stats (when not equipped). You have 65,535 Coins, 99 of all items and equipment, and all field/battle abilities.
format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave" header) that mGBA's reader rejects: string field at 0x29 claims 0x2f382f35 bytes, past the end of the file

note: Hand-assembled in 2018 and malformed: the date string follows a length field of 0, and the payload size field says 0x2001C where 8192 bytes follow with no checksum after them, so mGBA's reader (and this converter, which follows it) cannot find the payload. The cart header names "MARIOLUIGI" without the "&" of the real title, which mGBA would refuse anyway. Its payload is also byte-swapped in 32-bit units ("PG\x04\x00MALR"), against both the GameShark and the emulator order.
